text: Record an expense with payer, amount, description, participants
Expense amount is split equally among participants
Expenses persist in a JSON file across invocations
Show each person's balance (net paid minus owed)
Compute a settlement plan of transfers that settles all balances
Settlement uses a greedy algorithm aiming at minimum number of transfers (largest debtor/creditor matching)
Supports a group of people (multiple persons, payer may or may not be a participant)
Invalid input (non-positive/non-numeric amount, no participants) rejected with error, not crash or silent corruption
Monetary rounding handled so balances sum to zero and settlement is exact (e.g. 10 split 3 ways)
